messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "especially when an agent with greater diuretic potential is desired"
set: ["especially when an agent with greater diuretic potential is desired", "especially diuretic or water pill", "IV administration indicated when rapid onset of diuresis is desired", "used with diuretic", "process continues until the desired diuretic effect has been obtained", "diuretic", "symptoms especially reported when stopped abruptly", "need to discuss potential risk with doctor", "experience with daily doses greater than 20 mg is very minimal", "dose that provided the desired diuretic effect once or twice a day", "especially diuretic or water pill that may increase blood potassium", "potassium-sparing diuretic", "loop diuretic", "risk is high when the dose is changed", "greater than 95%", "especially lithium"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
